subject.title: fix(agents): cloud thinking models time out at 120s during reasoning (#80349) [AI-assisted]

question: Should this timeout-default change require a completed live Gemini thinking run before merge, after the call-site metadata bug is fixed?
rationale: The source-level fix is plausible, but the PR changes a compatibility-sensitive timeout default and the contributor's available Google proof stopped at HTTP 429 rather than a completed after-fix user path.

options.title: Require Live Proof After Refresh
options.body: Ask for a rebased PR plus redacted live Gemini embedded-run logs, copied output, or a recording showing the roughly 125s timeout no longer occurs.

options.title: Accept Source-Level Proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the resolver and fake-timer proof plus the runtime tradeoff if live Google quota is unavailable.

options.title: Replace With Maintainer Patch
options.body: If the contributor cannot refresh the branch and supply proof, keep the canonical issue open and carry the narrow fix in a maintainer-owned patch.

recommendation.title: Require Live Proof After Refresh
recommendation.body: Ask for a rebased PR plus redacted live Gemini embedded-run logs, copied output, or a recording showing the roughly 125s timeout no longer occurs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the most recent current-main timeout metadata and is the best available owner for the proof and compatibility tradeoff.
